(n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

original:
For every positive integer $n$ ,

 $\mathbb{E}^{n}\not\to(\ell_{3},\alpha\ell_{17})$ 

for all but finitely many $\alpha>0$ . More precisely, this holds
whenever $\alpha^{2}$ is irrational, or $\alpha^{2}=a/b$ in lowest
terms with $a+b/50\geq 37$ , or

 $\frac{7}{152}\leq\alpha^{2}\leq\frac{179}{3600}.$
